description.value: The Courtyard Café is a volunteer-run café tucked inside the main lobby of Delta Hospital in Delta, BC, operated by the Delta Hospital Auxiliary Society since the 1960s. It serves freshly made seasonal fare—sandwiches, wraps, salads, and daily specials—sourced in part from local Windset Farms, with outdoor seating beside the hospital's tranquil courtyard gardens. Proceeds support critical equipment and programs at the Delta Hospital Campus of Care, making every purchase a community contribution.
